title: Oven Roasted Peruvian Fish Tiradito
description: A light and refreshing Peruvian dish featuring roasted fish, clotted cream, and sashimi-cut fish, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is a low sodium friendly version of the traditional tiradito.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the halibut fillets with salt, black pepper, and coriander.
Place the halibut fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle with olive oil.
Roast the halibut in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, mix the clotted cream, lime juice, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Stir in the chopped aji amarillo peppers into the cream mixture.
Once the fish is done, let it cool for a few minutes before slicing it into thin pieces.
To serve, place the sliced fish on a plate and spoon the cream mixture over the top.
Garnish with additional aji amarillo peppers if desired.
